5: 本轮有 **2 项新发现（2 P2）**；两种 URI 输出表现合并为一项，重复打开与可能陈旧的诊断合并为一项。候选和历史问题均不加进此数量。证据直接导入当前 `packages/coding/src`，在真实 workspace manager 上注入内存 client；没有启动语言服务器或其他产品进程，没有网络调用。

7: ## CODING-R4-01 [P2] Definition / References 将编码 URI 当作文件路径返回
8: 
9: - 源码：`packages/coding/src/tools/lsp.ts:199–210`，核心为第 208 行的 `uri.replace("file://", "")`；两个实际入口为第 96–110 行。工具注册与调用路径见 `packages/coding/src/index.capability.ts:190–202`，它是 Coding preset 的实际 LSP 实现。
10: - 触发：语言服务器正常返回一个 `Location`，其文件名含空格、中文、`%` 或 `#`。工具请求端第 91 行正确使用 `pathToFileURL`，结果端却只去掉 scheme，没有进行 URI 解码。
11: - 观察：夹具创建真实临时文件 `a b-中文-100%#file.ts`；Definition 返回的路径保留 `%20`、UTF-8 百分号编码、`%25`、`%23`。原文件存在，而该返回路径不存在。References 同样保留 `reference%20space.ts`。ASCII 文件和 1-based 行号控制通过。
12: - 影响：Agent 按返回的 `path:line` 定位、读取或编辑普通含空格/非 ASCII 文件时，得到与实际文件不同的路径。此处确认的是工具输出失真，不是 GUI 点击导航或真实语言服务器故障。Windows/UNC 未运行，不把平台推断当作实测。
13: - 修复方向：对 `file:` Location 使用平台文件 URL 转换；对其他 URI scheme 保留可识别的 URI。此次没有实施修复。
14: - 去重：2026-05-30 的历史 finding 是 **manager 的 spawn cwd** 使用同类 replace；当前 `lsp/root-path.ts:11–12` 已用 `fileURLToPath` 修复，该正常行为也在本轮通过控制。当前项是仍未修复的 **工具结果 consumer**，不同源码位置和用户影响；没有把旧 manager 问题重复计入。10-16、10-17、round3 及 review 系列未找到此结果 formatter finding，详见 [去重回执](evidence/coding-dedup.json)。
15: - 证据：[夹具](evidence/coding-lsp-data.test.ts)、[首跑原始 stdout+stderr](evidence/coding-lsp-data.first.log)、[退出码](evidence/coding-lsp-data.first.exit.txt)。

17: ## CODING-R4-02 [P2] 重复 getDiagnostics 不同步已打开文件的编辑
18: 
19: - 源码：`packages/coding/src/tools/lsp.ts:135–158`，特别是第 156–157 行每次都发送 `textDocument/didOpen`，固定 `version: 1`。整个工具没有 `didChange` / `didClose`。Manager 按 cwd 复用已初始化 client，见 `packages/coding/src/lsp/manager.ts:42–43,253–258`；因此同一 workspace 的连续调用不是新协议 session。
20: - 触发：对一个文件调用 `getDiagnostics`，修改磁盘内容，再对同一文件调用 `getDiagnostics`。[LSP 3.17 官方 didOpen 合同](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/language-server-protocol/gh-pages/_specifications/lsp/3.17/textDocument/didOpen.md)要求 open/close 成对、同一时刻最多打开一次；打开后内容由 client 管理。已打开文档的变更应使用同步更新或先关闭再重开，重复 `didOpen` 不构成合法的内容更新。官方源由本轮 root 独立只读核对；本 Coding 执行未访问网络。
21: - 观察：真实工具首次发送 `BROKEN\n`，临时文件随后改成 `export const fixed = true;\n`。第二次仍发送 `didOpen`、`version: 1`，且没有更新/关闭消息。保留首次打开文档的严格内存 adapter 再发布旧内容的诊断，真实工具返回 `Old text is broken`。这证明非法通知序列，以及在该 adapter 下磁盘已修复而诊断仍旧；未声称任何特定真实服务器已经实测。
22: - 影响：语言服务器可能保留首次打开的文档、拒绝重复打开、或不再发布诊断，后续检查无法可靠对应当前磁盘内容。在本轮 fake adapter 下观察到的是陈旧结果；没有执行 10 秒不发布分支，也没有将假设的等待计为第二项。
23: - 修复方向：记录已同步文档及版本，按服务器协商的同步方式发送变更；或对独立磁盘检查采用成对 open/close。诊断的版本/请求相关性应和此同步策略一起处理。此次没有实施修复。
24: - 去重：历史 2026-05-30 diagnostics finding 是固定等待 2 秒且不收集通知，当前第 138–174 行已收集与格式化诊断；本项关注重复检查时的文档内容同步。旧 N15/N16（启动失败、死 client、并发 cold start）均排除、未重跑。详见 [去重回执](evidence/coding-dedup.json)。
25: - 证据：[夹具](evidence/coding-lsp-data.test.ts)、[首跑原始 stdout+stderr](evidence/coding-lsp-data.first.log)、[退出码](evidence/coding-lsp-data.first.exit.txt)。

84: ### C4 [P2] Failed LSP starts do not have complete error and process ownership
85: 
86: Sources:
87: 
88: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/client.ts:48`
89: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/manager.ts:72`
90: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/manager.ts:84`
91: 
92: Two observed launch-failure manifestations share incomplete startup lifecycle ownership. (a) ChildProcess emits `error` for a now-invalid cwd/missing interpreter after availability probing. LSPClient installs exit but no error handler; native Node raises an unhandled error and terminates the host. (b) A running language server rejects initialize; manager catches and returns undefined, but client is scoped inside try and assigned to managed.client only after successful initialize. The live failed child cannot be reached by shutdownAll; repeated attempts can accumulate children.
93: 
94: Owned executable normal server initialized and shut down. Owned initialize-error server left PID alive after manager.getClient returned undefined and manager.shutdownAll completed. Fixture explicitly SIGKILLed that owned PID. Separate owned native host with missing cwd exited1, stderr classified `Unhandled 'error' event` + ENOENT. Happy native handshake is the availability/stdio normal control. No real language-server install, user process or interpreter invoked.
95: 
96: Recommendation: own the child from spawn onward, turn async spawn errors into the awaited startup failure, and close failed initialization in finally/catch with bounded exit escalation.

98: ### C5 [P2] LSP readiness state can return a dead client or false unavailable result
99: 
100: Sources:
101: 
102: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/client.ts:58`
103: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/client.ts:154`
104: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/manager.ts:42`
105: - `/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/remaining-modules-review-20261012/codeshell/packages/coding/src/lsp/manager.ts:46`
106: 
107: The manager's ready/starting decisions do not represent actual completion and liveness. After a server exits, process remains assigned and process.killed remains false (it means kill() was called, not process exited); manager keeps returning the same dead client. New LSP operations cannot recover by lazy restart. Concurrent cold calls instead wait a fixed2s and return managed.client regardless of initialize state; a valid server taking2.2s to initialize yields undefined to the second caller while the first succeeds. LSP tool reports server unavailable/install advice in this branch.
108: 
109: Owned server exited3 after initialize: isAlive=true and next manager.getClient returned the exact same object. Separate2200ms initialize: second call after20ms returned undefined, first then returned ready. Happy handshake/shutdown is the normal control. Fixture clears its private dead client handle before shutdown solely to avoid spending the known30s request timeout in test cleanup; product's broken state is asserted before that test-only cleanup.
110: 
111: Recommendation: share a startup promise; invalidate client/state on terminal child events and distinguish exited/failed/starting from ready.
